messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH CPU/queue pressure in us-east-2 inference pool for model redwood-4x. Severity: P1. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-8811 :rotating_light:

pd-bot: PagerDuty alert sent to #incidents and on-call group. Escalation level: 1/3. Incident key: INC-8811

alex_prod_oncall: acked in PD. I'm on it — grabbing metrics and logs now.

maria_sre: noted big spike in batch-queue length on az us-east-2-az1. KV cache evictions also rising. Could be a batch consumer loop.

jonathan_eng: seeing a spike from the nightly retrain job hitting GPUs: logs:
```
[2026-03-14T02:14:32Z] queue_processor: batch_size=512 -> enqueue rate 18k/s
[2026-03-14T02:14:40Z] gpu-pool: usage=98% pods=120/120
```

alex_prod_oncall: starting controlled fallback to reduce pressure. Running: 
```
roctl routing failover activate --from-region us-east-2 --to-region us-west-1 --models redwood-4x --initial-weight 0.05
```
Setting initial weight 5% to test.

deploy-bot: Route change applied (5% to us-west-1). config-id: rfc-2026-332. Canary healthchecks initiated.

support-lead: preliminary customer impact — ~2% 503s for requests originating from APAC and East coast. TTR needed for external comms?

alex_prod_oncall: noted. @support-lead please draft a short status for affected customers: brief, avoid technical detail. We'll share once we have ETA. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: I'm scaling the autoscaler temporarily for the us-east-2 GPU pool and evicting low-priority batch pods.
```
kubectl scale deploy gpu-worker --replicas=140 -n inference
kubectl delete pod -l job=batch-lowpri -n inference
```

jonathan_eng: after evictions, queue dropped 60% in 2 minutes. However GPU utilization still high; bumping canary to 30% to relieve queue faster.

alex_prod_oncall: Increasing fallback weight to 30% now.
```
roctl routing failover patch --config rfc-2026-332 --set-weight 0.30
```

deploy-bot: Route update successful. Canary traffic at 30%. Healthchecks: pass=99/100, avg latency on us-west-1 120ms.

lisa_platform: PD escalation note: paged platform lead and infra-oncall at escalation level 2 due to potential capacity exhaustion. Please keep updates in thread for postmortem.

pd-bot: PD: alex_prod_oncall acknowledged; escalation to platform lead (michael_platform) executed.

support-lead: customer status draft:
"We're experiencing intermittent request errors and elevated latency for some customers in the affected region. We've activated automatic failover and are actively mitigating. No data loss. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes."

alex_prod_oncall: good. Sending now. Also enabling burst capacity for dedicated tenants to reduce failed requests.

maria_sre: burst capacity enabled for dedicated pools in us-east-2. Monitoring KV cache recovery; eviction rate decreasing.

jonathan_eng: running quick check on cache hit ratio: improved from 62% -> 81% after evictions and fallback traffic.

alex_prod_oncall: error rate falling from 3.4% -> 0.8% over last 10m. Latency 95th pctl trending down. Keeping fallback at 30% for now. Preparing to hand back to normal ops in 45m if stable.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8811 status: mitigated -> partial recovery. Current severity: P2. Actions taken: routing fallback to us-west-1 (30%), autoscaler scaled +20 nodes, burst capacity enabled, low-priority jobs evicted. Runbook: https://runbook.redwood/infra/fallback

alex_prod_oncall: requesting post-incident follow-ups: schedule a blameless postmortem, determine why retrain hit production GPU pool, and tighten batch job scheduling windows.

support-lead: customers notified; will post an update to status.redwood.com in 10 minutes with current mitigation and ETA for full recovery.

maria_sre: adding timeline and relevant graphs to the incident doc now.

alex_prod_oncall: ack. I'll remove PD escalation once we hit steady-state for 30m. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: page cleared for INC-8811. Final status: partial recovery; follow-up required. :white_check_mark:
